ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390x844) the sticky tally bar bbox x=16..374 y=780..828 FULLY overlaps the 'Made with Emergent' badge at x=196..374 y=788..828 — the PASS/FAIL/N/A counts and the × dismiss button sit directly behind or beside the badge. The collapsed TALLY chip (x=255..374 y=800..828) sits ENTIRELY behind the Emergent badge, making it tap-blocked on real devices. The recent paddingRight:env(safe-area-inset-right) fix only reserves OS safe-area (notch/punch-hole) and does not reserve space for the Emergent preview badge (which is ~180px wide and permanently anchored bottom-right). During testing `page.click(force=True)` on the restore chip did NOT flip state on the first attempt — only a JS dispatchEvent click worked — strongly indicating the Emergent badge is intercepting pointer events.

action_items: Fix TALLY bar + chip overlap with Emergent badge on mobile. Suggested options (pick one): (a) Add `pr-[11rem] sm:pr-3` to the outer wrapper so the counts clear the ~180px badge on small screens, or better: wrap the counts div with `mr-[11rem] sm:mr-0`. (b) Apply the same `mr-[11rem] sm:mr-0` to the collapsed chip so the chip floats LEFT of the badge. (c) Alternatively raise the bar with `bottom-20 sm:bottom-4` on mobile so it sits ABOVE the badge instead of beside it. Only the FIRST option keeps the bar readable without blocking the content above. After fix, re-verify chip is tappable with a normal (non-JS) click in playwright at viewport 390x844.

rca of the issue: RCA — NewEquipmentInspection.jsx applies `paddingRight: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-right))` to the sticky tally bar. env(safe-area-inset-right) is the OS-level safe-area (iPhone notch / rounded-corner padding) and evaluates to 0 on most devices and in the preview browser. It does NOT reserve space for the 'Made with Emergent' floating anchor that Emergent injects in the bottom-right corner of preview and *.emergentagent.com URLs (bbox ≈196x788 to 374x828 on 390-wide viewport). Result: the entire right half of the tally bar, including the × dismiss on the left AND the PASS/FAIL/N/A counters, overlays the badge; the collapsed chip (which uses `ml-auto`) sits 100% underneath the badge and is not tappable with a real click on preview/deployed Emergent URLs. Mitigation: replace the paddingRight inline style with a responsive right-margin on the inner counts div (e.g. `mr-44 sm:mr-0` → ~176px → clears badge) and on the collapsed chip wrapper, and/or lift the whole bar with `bottom-20 sm:bottom-4`. This regression does NOT affect mascidocs.com production because Emergent only injects the badge on preview and emergentagent.com URLs — but it IS user-visible on any testing/staging viewer on a phone.
